title: Implement one project milestone
whenToUse: You have a written milestone with acceptance criteria and want the smallest vertical slice.
whenNotToUse: You need research or design consensus first, or the requirement is still ambiguous.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Implement ONLY milestone {{milestoneId}}: {{milestoneObjective}}.

CONTEXT:
Project {{projectId}}. Existing patterns in {{pathHints}}.

INPUT:
Requirements:
{{requirements}}

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not implement later milestones
- No dependency additions unless justified and verified
- No unrelated refactors
- Keep secrets out of the repo

OUTPUT:
1) Plan (brief)
2) Code changes
3) Tests/validation added
4) Manual verification steps

ACCEPTANCE:
{{acceptanceCriteria}}

VERIFICATION:
Run: {{verificationCommands}}
Paste actual command output. Stop at milestone boundary.
badPrompt: Build the whole app for me.
improvedPrompt:
GOAL:
Implement ONLY milestone PBL-AI-B-002-M01: repository inspection notes + PROJECT_PLAN.md.
CONSTRAINTS:
No application feature code yet; markdown plan only.
ACCEPTANCE:
Plan lists architecture, risks, and next milestone boundary.
VERIFICATION:
Show git status; only PROJECT_PLAN.md added.
expectedOutput: A bounded diff that satisfies one milestone plus real command evidence.
privacySecurityNotes: Avoid copying proprietary code from other repos into prompts
